description: Desktop capability for the main ZUULI window. No f2zmsg:* grant: ZUULI has no messaging frontend (#904 phase 3 moved it to wallet/e2e2z), and the seed-holding WebView must reach no command it cannot use (#916). Enrollment stays in this app as three app-crate commands that need the seed and are not plugin commands, so no capability grants them - see src-tauri/src/messaging.rs.
